title: Add Admin backend: permissions, lifecycle writes, read-model, bespoke router, demo wiring
description: No schema migration needed -- app_user/role/role_permission/audit_log already exist from TASK-024. src/auth/permissions.ts gains usersRead/usersManage/rolesRead/rolesWrite keys. src/auth/lifecycle.ts gains setUserActiveWithin (rejects self-disable), createRoleWithin (unique name per master, isSuperadmin always false), setRolePermissionWithin (rejects editing the superadmin role, validates permissionKey against Object.values(PERMISSIONS)) -- all audited via appendAudit, mirroring lifecycle.ts's existing createInvitation/acceptInvitation style exactly. src/api/admin.ts (new) provides listCompanyUsers (real appUser+userCompany+role joined for the company, UNIONed with pending userInvitation rows), listRoles, listRolePermissions, listAuditLog (paginated, actor name resolved) -- mirrors src/api/dashboard.ts's plain-function shape, no ResourceDefinition. src/api/routes/admin.ts (new) exposes GET /api/admin/users, POST /api/admin/users/:userId/actions/toggle-active, POST /api/admin/invitations (reuses existing createInvitation), GET/POST /api/admin/roles, GET /api/admin/role-permissions, POST /api/admin/roles/:roleId/actions/set-permission, GET /api/admin/audit-log -- mirrors routes/auth.ts's manual hasPermission+scope style, not the generic resource dispatcher (deliberately: these tables are excluded from RLS company-scope by design per deploy/sql/production-rls.sql, and structurally don't fit ResourceDefinition's single-id-column cursor pagination -- appUser's PK is userId, role's is roleId, role_permission has a composite PK with no id column at all). Mounted in src/api/app.ts alongside /api/auth and /api/setup. Demo side: erp-demo-runtime-impl.ts gains matching commands (createInvitation needs a demo-only fixed LifecycleOptions token key + publicUrl, mirroring how the production integration test already supplies a fixed key). erp-system-data-adapter.js exposes the real signed-in appUser.userId as state.activeUserId (already available as activeUser.user_id in readPayload()'s d.users query, just not currently surfaced), special-cases list()/create()/action() for admin/users, admin/roles, admin/role-permissions, admin/audit-log, admin/invitations (NOT added to RESOURCE_TABLES, matching the bespoke-not-generic decision), and -- the key structural fix found during research -- adds appendAudit-equivalent calls at the single generic create()/action() dispatch chokepoint using state.activeUserId, since appendAudit today is only ever called from the production HTTP layer (actionDispatcher.ts/routes/resources.ts/routes/auth.ts/lifecycle.ts/completeSetup.ts) and never by any src/modules/** business module directly, meaning audit_log has been permanently empty in browser demo mode for every module, not just this one -- this one mechanical addition retroactively gives every existing Canonical write (asset creation, PO receipt, etc.) a real demo-mode audit trail too. DONE 2026-07-19: implemented mostly as planned, with two real corrections found during implementation (both documented here since the plan didn't anticipate them). (1) node:crypto boundary: lifecycle.ts hard-imports ./password and ./tokenCrypto (node:crypto), so importing anything from it into web/src/erp-demo-runtime-impl.ts made npm run build:demo fail outright ('randomBytes is not exported by __vite-browser-external') -- not just a warning. Fixed by extracting AuthLifecycleError into a dependency-free src/auth/authErrors.ts, and moving setUserActiveWithin/createRoleWithin/setRolePermissionWithin plus a new demo-only createInvitationRecordWithin (Web Crypto token instead of encryptToken/newOpaqueToken, no outbox event -- nothing in-browser would ever consume it) into a new src/auth/adminLifecycle.ts with a verified-clean (no node:crypto) import graph. (2) transaction nesting: the demo adapter always pre-wraps *Within calls in its own requireDemoDb().transaction(function(tx){...}), but my first draft of the 3 admin-lifecycle functions self-transacted via withTenantTransaction internally -- calling .transaction() on an already-in-progress PGlite transaction throws 'this.client.transaction is not a function'. Fixed by splitting each into a raw-exec ...Within(exec,...) core (no transaction-opening, matches every other module's convention exactly) plus a thin self-transacting wrapper (setUserActive/createRole/setRolePermission) for routes/admin.ts, which calls with a top-level db exactly like routes/auth.ts already calls createInvitation. Also found and fixed a double-audit bug live in-browser: the generic recordDemoAudit chokepoint in erp-system-data-adapter.js's create()/action() wrappers was firing for admin/* resources even though their business logic already self-audits (matching production, where routes/admin.ts never audits a second time either) -- fixed by skipping entity.indexOf('admin/')===0 in recordDemoAudit. Full suite green: typecheck x2, npm test 163 passed/1 skipped (6 new tests in src/auth/adminLifecycle.test.ts, split from lifecycle.test.ts to match the file split), npm run demo, npm run build:demo (clean, no node:crypto errors), check:demo-schema/check:drift (no migration needed, 0 drift), npm run audit:screens (114 routes, 50 canonical unchanged -- screens are TASK-042), npm run smoke. Manually verified in a real PGlite browser session (window.ErpSystemData.reset()): admin/users, admin/roles, admin/role-permissions, admin/audit-log all return real seeded data (2 users, 2 roles, Viewer's 9 real permission grants); created a role, granted it a permission, toggled a user off and back on, created an invitation -- all real writes, all succeeded; confirmed the demo-mode audit-log fix works end-to-end by creating an unrelated asset and seeing a real audit_log row appear (entity 'assets/assets', actor 'Admin'); confirmed exactly one audit row per write after the double-audit fix (6 writes -> 6 rows, not 12).

title: Migrate hand-rolled modals to appModal(); add requireField() helper
description: ui.js's appModal({icon,title,body,actions,width}) is already documented as the SSOT for modal chrome but only used in 10 of 22 screen files; the rest hand-roll the identical modal-head markup inline via raw openModal(). Migrate the remaining hand-rolled sites onto appModal(). Also add a shared requireField()/validateRequired() helper to screens-common.js replacing the copy-pasted if(!x){toast(...);focus();return} pattern scattered across screens, preserving each call site's exact message text and focus target. DONE 2026-07-19: two-part refactor, both mechanical, both verified. (1) Migrated 23 of 24 hand-rolled modal-head call sites across 12 files (app.js, screens-admin/asset/crm/fin-new/inv-adjust/inv/mfg/ops/people/project/purchase.js) onto the existing appModal() SSOT in ui.js -- the 1 deliberate exception (app.js keyboard-shortcuts modal) has a custom non-modal-foot footer that does not fit the {icon,title,body,actions} shape and was left alone rather than force-fit. Critical correctness rule enforced throughout: appModal() escapes the title internally, so every title that previously wrapped an interpolated value in esc(...) had that esc() stripped to avoid double-escaping (e.g. 'Delete <esc(m.name)>?' -> 'Delete <m.name>?'); body/actions content keeps its own esc() calls unchanged since appModal() does not touch them. Delegated to a general-purpose agent with explicit escaping-rule instructions given the volume (24 sites); independently reviewed the full diff myself before trusting it (all title-escaping cases correct, all post-modal DOM wiring untouched) and re-ran the full verification suite personally rather than trusting the agent's own report alone. The helper accepts either a string selector (resolved via the global $()) or an already-resolved DOM element, needed because 2 sites (screens-ops.js) focus within a modal-scoped querySelector rather than the document-global one. Bumped sw.js CACHE_VERSION (v33->v34, also covering the untracked v33->v34 gap for TASK-047/048 which touched precached files without a version bump) for a clean verification baseline. Full suite green: typecheck x2, npm test (171 passed/1 skipped, no regressions), npm run demo, npm run build:demo, npm run audit:screens (114 routes, 54 canonical / 60 preview, zero regressions), npm run smoke (desktop+mobile). Live-verified in fresh browser tabs, zero console errors: Admin Invite-user modal and Fixed-Assets New-asset modal both render correctly post-migration; requireField() unit-tested directly in a live page context (truthy passthrough, empty-value toast+return-false, string-selector focus, real end-to-end empty-name submit on the New-asset form visibly focusing the name field and blocking submission). title: Interactive scripts/setup.sh --interactive + docker-compose DATABASE_URL fix
description:

New `make setup-interactive` target. Update docs/SETUP_WIZARD.md (mark the interactive-prompts Future item done) and docs/DEPLOYMENT.md (short external-database section).

Broaden the shared Posting Detail contract to cover immutable inventory postings, then render receipt identity, source facts, controlled order lines, stock-movement evidence and stock-effect context without changing Canonical purchasing or inventory reads. Service worker v103 delivers the corrected UI.
acceptance: goods-receipt declares and renders posting-detail-v1 with overview, error, main, context and hidden actions regions in canonical order
The page renders one semantic header and no docwrap, docpage, dochead, docmeta, doclayout, summary card or redundant Back action
Receipt lines and inventory movements are bounded independently; received quantity and movement counts remain derived from Canonical data
View stock movements is the single header navigation action, while the footer actions region remains hidden and empty
Five-language populated/no-movement/unknown/empty/read-failure/Retry states and desktop/375px overflow are audited
Lint, dual typecheck, tests, schema/drift/PGlite checks, Demo/API builds, smoke, 43-route list audit, 3-route posting-detail audit and full 115-route audit pass before local commit-only handoff

title: Add organisation username login and multi-role assignments
description: Add organisation login codes, organisation-scoped usernames, nullable pre-activation email, multiple company-role grants and a non-destructive migration path for existing accounts. DONE 2026-07-25: migration 0046 adds unique master.login_code, master-scoped app_user.username, nullable email and user_company_role; deterministic compatibility backfill preserves every email account and copies each existing company role exactly once. Production login resolves normalized organisation code before username, setup captures both identifiers, permission checks union only active-company roles, and User Management exposes one audited multi-role action. Service worker v104 delivers the updated assets; 47-migration PGlite retry proof, 134-table drift, 399 tests plus one expected skip, Demo/API builds, smoke and all 115 desktop/375px routes pass without changing the 115/0 route baseline.
acceptance: The same username may exist in different organisations while duplicates within one organisation are rejected
Existing email accounts and single-role grants migrate without privilege expansion or data loss
Authentication resolves organisation before username and preserves tenant isolation

title: Link Employee to app_user and implement HR account lifecycle
description: Create the company-unique Employee/app_user binding, encrypted recoverable activation credential, audited HR reveal, mandatory first-login completion, HR reset and immediate offboarding revocation.
acceptance: HR may reveal the one-time password only before activation and every reveal is audited
First login requires password replacement and an email, then permanently destroys the recoverable temporary credential
Offboarding revokes active sessions and transfers outstanding work without deleting history

title: Add actor-owned /api/my contracts
description: Introduce employee self-service APIs whose employee identity is derived exclusively from the authenticated Session, with separate management permissions and reporting-line scopes.
acceptance: Self-service endpoints do not accept a client-selected employeeId
ID tampering cannot read, upload, submit or void another employee's data
Manager and authorised hierarchy scopes remain company-bound and are independently tested

title: Build the five-language My Work shell
description: Add My Leave, My Claims and My Receipts entry points, plus Team Calendar and Approvals for employees with management capability, using existing SSOT page contracts.
acceptance: Employee navigation exposes only capabilities granted by the active role union and data scope
All new shell states support English, Malay, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Vietnamese
Existing Canonical routes and the 115-route baseline remain unchanged until feature acceptance

title: Prove identity migration, access and security boundaries
description: Verify cross-organisation username reuse, activation and reset, multi-role permission union, manager assignment, hierarchy access, session revocation and the accepted optional MFA/email-verification controls.
acceptance: Automated tests cover activation-secret destruction, HR reset, offboarding and cross-tenant denial
Multiple roles union permissions without widening company, employee or reporting-tree scope
Security documentation records that MFA, step-up authentication and email verification are optional accepted risks

title: Add working calendars, holidays, leave types and policy versions
description: Model versioned workdays, official holiday drafts, confirmed company holidays, full-day and half-day leave types, entitlement, accrual, carry, evidence, staffing and encashment rules.
acceptance: HR confirmation is required before official holiday drafts affect calculations
Policy and calendar versions are effective-dated and retained for historical reconstruction
Hourly leave is rejected while full-day and half-day requests calculate deterministically

title: Add the immutable leave balance ledger
description: Represent grants, accrual, reservations, use, releases, cancellation, adjustment, carry-forward, expiry and encashment as append-only leave balance entries.
acceptance: Pending requests reserve paid balance and later outcomes append release or consumption entries
Insufficient paid balance blocks submission and offers an explicit paid/unpaid split
Balance projections reconcile exactly to the immutable ledger

title: Add complete leave application lifecycle and evidence
description: Implement Draft, Pending, Approved, Rejected, Withdrawn, Voided and Cancelled semantics, versioned amendments, approved cancellation, HR on-behalf entry and privacy-controlled medical evidence.
acceptance: Each transition enforces version, permission, CSRF, idempotency and an audit reason where required
Submitted records use Void or correction flows instead of destructive deletion
Managers see dates, duration and evidence state while raw reason and attachments remain limited to employee and HR

title: Add configurable approval, delegation and capacity controls
description: Add policy-driven approval levels, direct-manager defaults, self-approval prevention, bounded delegation, reminders, escalation and department minimum-staff actions.
acceptance: Approval steps can vary by leave type, days, department and amount without permitting self-approval
Delegation is time-bounded and preserves the original authority and decision audit
Capacity policy can warn, add an approval level or block approval

title: Add calendar-workspace-v1 and outbound calendar sync
description: Create the shared month/week/list team calendar with filters, privacy-redacted availability, conflict indicators, detail drawer decisions and optional one-way external calendar jobs.
acceptance: The workspace renders the standard header, filters, calendar, detail, error and actions regions
Direct managers default to direct reports while authorised department heads may expand to the reporting tree
Approved, changed and cancelled events sync outward idempotently while ERP remains the source of truth

title: Connect leave to Payroll and migrate HR-lite safely
description: Generate Payroll deduction sources for approved unpaid leave and earning sources for policy-approved encashment while preserving legacy leave day snapshots and route compatibility.
acceptance: Payroll effects are idempotent, traceable to the leave revision and never duplicated
Legacy rows retain original days, are marked Legacy Policy and are not recalculated
Five-language Demo/API proofs cover migration, balance and payroll outcomes

title: Introduce DocumentStorageProvider and receipt metadata
description: Create a provider boundary for database binary storage and optional single-node filesystem storage while the database owns tenant, hash, MIME, version, retention, legal-hold and audit metadata.
acceptance: PostgreSQL and PGlite byte storage are the default and pass identical authorization tests
Filesystem storage is explicitly single-node and never becomes the metadata source of truth
Content hashes, versions and tenant ownership are immutable and queryable

title: Add secure upload and mobile offline capture
description: Accept bounded JPEG, PNG, HEIC and PDF uploads with magic-byte validation, camera capture, crop, rotate, compression and offline PWA drafts.
acceptance: Uploads enforce 20 MB per file and 20 pages per PDF before processing
Declared MIME and extension cannot bypass content validation
Logout warns about and then clears unsynchronised local document drafts

title: Add quarantine scanning and asynchronous extraction
description: Keep new documents quarantined until malware scanning succeeds, then run retry-safe local OCR or explicitly enabled BYOK Vision extraction through jobs and outbox events.
acceptance: Unavailable or indeterminate scanning prevents preview, OCR, submission and export
Local OCR is the default and external Vision requires company provider, region and retention configuration
Job retries do not duplicate documents, extraction versions or downstream submissions

title: Add confidence-governed receipt inbox and auto-submit
description: Store extracted-field source, model and confidence; allow system submission for the authenticated uploader only when every critical field reaches 98% and all safety, amount and duplicate checks pass.
acceptance: A company may disable auto-submit but cannot configure a confidence threshold below 98%
Low-confidence or conflicting fields enter explicit human review
Automated submission records the employee's prior upload authorization and the system actor

title: Add document void retention and purge governance
description: Define draft deletion, reasoned Void, posted correction/reversal, tax finalisation, legal hold, paper-original custody and two-person permanent purge after retention.
acceptance: Only unsubmitted drafts can be directly deleted
Submitted or approved records follow state-dependent Void while posted or sealed records require reversal or correction versions
Authorised purge requires records-manager initiation and Finance review and retains a hash tombstone

title: Audit document access and storage parity
description: Audit sensitive view, download, print and export operations and prove provider parity, quarantine isolation, privacy, tenant scope, retries and responsive PWA behavior.
acceptance: Every sensitive content access records actor, tenant, purpose, document version and timestamp
Database and filesystem providers produce equivalent authorization, retention and hash results
Desktop and 375px upload, quarantine, review and failure states have no page overflow

title: Add effective-dated expense tax FX and GL policy
description: Configure expense categories, evidence, limits, tax deductibility, input tax, payment source, GL mapping and exchange-rate rules with effective-dated versions.
acceptance: Every submitted line snapshots the applicable policy version and original/base currency facts
Verified actual bank charge may override policy FX only with Finance evidence and audit
All money calculations use Decimal and configured tax treatment

title: Add multi-line claims receipt inbox and allocation
description: Support direct multi-line claim creation and quick receipt capture with merchant, date, purpose, currency, tax, payment source and department, cost-centre or project allocation.
acceptance: Allocation by amount or percentage must reconcile exactly to each expense line
Employees control final submission, including explicit authorization for eligible automatic submission
Finance or HR cannot silently rewrite employee-owned claim facts

title: Add line-level approval duplicate and budget control
description: Add manager-plus-Finance approvals with configurable extra levels, line decisions, self-approval prevention, duplicate signals and warning, extra-approval or blocking budget policy.
acceptance: Approvers may approve, reject or return individual lines but cannot edit them
Hash, image and merchant/date/amount/tax-number signals contribute to duplicate risk
High-risk duplicate override requires Finance permission and a reasoned audit

title: Add corporate-card statement reconciliation
description: Import bounded CSV and Excel card statements, match holder, date, currency and amount to evidence, and retain unmatched or missing-receipt transactions in a follow-up queue.
acceptance: Imports validate schema, size, tenant and duplicate statement lines before apply
Automatic matches expose confidence and remain reviewable
Unmatched transactions and follow-up actions are persistent audited facts

title: Add mileage per diem and cash advances
description: Calculate mileage and per diem from versioned policies without fabricated receipts, and manage cash-advance issue, settlement and employee receivable/payable differences.
acceptance: Mileage and per diem retain rate, units, policy version and calculation evidence
Cash advances cannot close until application and repayment differences reconcile
Resulting receivable or payable postings are explicit, balanced and auditable

title: Post approved expenses and employee payables
description: On final Finance approval, post Expense/Input Tax against Employee Payable for employee-funded lines or the configured bank/card clearing account for company-funded lines.
acceptance: Each approved posting is balanced, Decimal-exact, period-valid and idempotent
Employee-paid and company-paid sources use different configured credit accounts
Posting failure leaves the approval recoverable and does not create partial ledger effects

title: Deliver five-language expense SSOT screens and proof
description: Deliver My Claims, My Receipts and approval screens through standard list and case-detail contracts with five-language, privacy and responsive state coverage.
acceptance: My Claims and My Receipts use the list SSOT and expense detail uses case-detail-v1
Partial decisions, FX, duplicate override, allocation, budget and posting failures are testable states
All desktop and 375px routes avoid page-level horizontal overflow

title: Add encrypted employee payout profiles
description: Store encrypted employee bank details with masked defaults, restricted reveal, HR/Finance verification, change audit and verification invalidation after modification.
acceptance: Unverified or modified payout profiles cannot enter a payment batch
Sensitive reveal and every change are permission-controlled and audited
Keys and unmasked account values never appear in logs or ordinary list APIs

title: Add maker checker reimbursement payment batches
description: Create reimbursement batches from posted unpaid employee payables and enforce a distinct preparer and releaser with self-payment exclusion.
acceptance: Only verified payout profiles and open posted payables are selectable
The releaser cannot be the preparer or release a batch containing their own claim
Batch membership and release snapshot become immutable at approval

title: Export bank files and import payment outcomes
description: Generate configured bank files, capture bank reference and per-line outcomes, retry failures independently and post successful reimbursement settlement without duplicate payment.
acceptance: Export artifacts are versioned, checksummed and access-audited
Only successful lines post Dr Employee Payable and Cr Bank
Failed lines remain retryable under stable idempotency keys and never duplicate successful payments

title: Build the Tax Evidence Center and report jobs
description: Filter tax evidence by period, category, project, tax state and completeness, then generate register, merged PDF, XLSX, CSV, original-file ZIP and SHA-256 manifest from one snapshot.
acceptance: All artifacts reconcile to the same immutable source snapshot and totals
Async generation is retryable without producing divergent versions
Sensitive view, download, print and export operations are audited

title: Add tax pack finalisation corrections and retention
description: Seal immutable tax-pack versions, create superseding corrections with difference manifests, enforce country/company retention and legal hold, and prevent silent evidence replacement.
acceptance: A sealed pack cannot be overwritten and late evidence creates a new linked version
Singapore defaults to at least five years and Malaysia to at least seven years retention
Longer company policy and legal hold override ordinary purge eligibility

title: Prove the complete employee to tax chain
description: Verify identity activation, leave and payroll effects, receipt upload, claim approval, balanced posting, maker/checker payment, bank result and immutable tax package across Demo/API and release gates.
acceptance: End-to-end proofs cover success, replay, partial failure, Void/correction and cross-tenant denial
Five languages, PWA/desktop/375px SSOT states and privacy boundaries pass
Lint, dual typecheck, full tests, builds, schema/drift/PGlite, smoke and all applicable audits pass before any planned route becomes Canonical
